standard-dialogue-trying-to-open-the-gat.text: The player attempts to open the Gate between Sophanem and Menaphos.

standard-dialogue-trying-to-open-the-gat.player: I'll not get through these gates; they're too heavily boarded up!
...And these walls don't look very climbable at all.

standard-dialogue-walking-away-from-the-.speaker: Menaphite guard
standard-dialogue-walking-away-from-the-.text: That's right, clear off. You're not welcome here!
